title: Language emergence (protocol par.3.8): meta-law compiled from 2 domains, atom reused in a 3rd; R1b budget-matched raw arm + R1c random-atom specificity control
code_repo: public GitHub repository of the engine (name on request)

data_hashes.fixture: synthetic in-code (LCG seeds 11/22/33; domains A/B/C), no external datasets

execution_environment.host: dev desktop (point-check; full suite runs on the dedicated runner laptop)
execution_environment.suite_note: LanguageVerify28Test 8/8 GREEN, 35 assertions (targeted); full two-pass suite 1226 tests GREEN on runner laptop (rc6, fast 1217 + slow 9, invariant 1226/1226); cross-class isolation check 13/13 in one process

baseline.reading: raw fails at BOTH configs (depth2/beam0 and depth3/beam10); with-atom solves exact cv=0; random atom does not solve -> atom-specific ENABLES at matched config. Cost parity NOT claimed: with-atom 6.1s vs raw_matched 2.1s, atom_birth 0.0s (bootstrap mint 0.001s). CV 9.99 = engine NOT_FOUND sentinel (no candidate passed), not a measured CV.

resources.note: peak_mem_bytes recorded in report meta (~286 MB); wall-clock per block in meta.secs; cost parity not claimed (with-atom 6.1 s vs raw-matched 2.1 s)

limitations: single-author system; not independently reproduced (V1.10-INDEPENDENT-IMPL open)
criterion v1.6 mean-form parity; A19 caveat applies to empirical data
reuse record in the fixture is invoked via Grammar::registerReuse (same public contract as live Hive::registerReuseOps), not observed from the production daemon
equal depth/beam = config parity; total cost of atom birth reported separately, cost parity not claimed
CV 9.99 in report rows with found=false is the NOT_FOUND sentinel, not a measured value

independent_replication.rule: automation does NOT raise this status; only an external attempt with artifacts
